description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveQualificationLicenseController' for handling the saving and editing of qualification license data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and determines which Vue component to load based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLicenseController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the save operation for qualification licenses, handling whether to display an edit or save component based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by selecting either the 'license-edit' or 'license-save' component depending on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
